title: What Is Staffing? Explained Simply | Principles of Management Ep 17
description:
Ravi's second Chai Corner opens in two weeks, and nobody is there to run it. Last time he hired the first person who asked, and it went badly. This time he follows the staffing process to find the right people.

You will learn what staffing means (filling every job with the right person, and keeping it filled), the 8 steps of staffing: manpower planning, recruitment, selection, placement and orientation, training and development, performance appraisal, promotion and transfer, and compensation. We also compare internal and external sources of recruitment, and see why recruitment is called positive and selection is called negative.

This is Episode 17 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
0:00 Outlet 2 has nobody to run it
0:25 What is staffing?
0:36 The 8 steps of staffing
0:51 Internal vs external sources
1:15 The hiring funnel: recruitment vs selection
1:33 Placement, training, appraisal, promotion and pay
2:05 Quick check
2:16 Recap
